method: Actual local browser screenshot viewed by the scene author; source translation code and bundled Three shader inspected read-only.
verdict: Source composition remains suitable and selected; visual fidelity requires correction/review. Not final visual, physical or release acceptance.
observed_strengths: Complete L-shaped fitted kitchen and island/stools create coherent room-scale composition.
Original cabinet fronts, window/shutters, hood, sink, worktop appliances and utensils supply substantially more credible detail than the old sparse preset.
Brick, wood and floor texture patterns are visible; source materials must remain intact.
observed_gaps: Diffuse and ambient illumination appear uniformly subdued and gray.
Weak contact/occlusion cues flatten the island and appliances; original castshadow=false is a source limit, not automatically an importer defect.
The near-square scene canvas crops lateral context, including much of the refrigerator/appliance stack, compared with the authored16:9 view.
The displayed Robot start label is an erroneous inspection UI annotation, not source geometry.

evidence: The bundled direct and indirect BlinnPhong diffuse evaluation both use BRDF_Lambert.
src/robot_worlds/static/scene.js passes source light diffuse and ambient coefficients directly, without compensating that renderer normalization.
translation_finding.interpretation: The extra1/PI normalization changes the source classic ambient/diffuse coefficient convention and is a concrete contributor to this dim result. Exact pixel equivalence with native OpenGL remains unproven.
translation_finding.approved_correction: In source-inspection Phong materials only, remove or compensate the extra1/PI factor in direct diffuse and indirect/ambient diffuse evaluation. Preserve stored source light/material coefficients, specular evaluation, texture/color-space pipeline, cameras and source physics.
translation_finding.excluded: No arbitrary exposure gain, source tint changes, material replacement, new lights, new shadows or environment map.

next_evidence.captures: One static fully loaded browser frame per authored view after the scoped shader correction. Verify canvas dimensions, not just outer window dimensions.

deeper_fidelity_direction: Review corrected source shading before any presentation relighting. If source castshadow=false, missing planar reflections or classic materials still fall below Homebody, author a separately identified presentation treatment; do not silently describe relit or substituted content as unchanged source rendering.
physical_boundary: 563 visual geoms,249 native bodies,67 joints and successful zero-step export establish inspectable source contents. Kinematic hinge/drawer control is not settling/contact/grasp/task evidence.
